title: Product Seller
description: Definition of Product Seller under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a person who, in the course of business, imports, sells, distributes, leases, installs, prepares, packages, labels, markets, repairs, maintains, or otherwise is involved in placing such product for commercial purpose
content.plain_language: a person or business that sells, distributes, or provides a product to consumers for a commercial purpose
examples: a company that manufactures and sells electronics
a retailer that sells clothing and accessories
non_examples: a person selling their used car privately

user_queries: Who is considered a product seller under the Consumer Protection Act?
What businesses are included in the definition of product seller?
